This ship sank four thousand seven hundred years ago.
And archaeologists say it may be the oldest shipwreck ever found.
It lies off Kekova Island, in southern Turkey... thirty meters down.
More than thirty clay jars, and three stone anchors, still resting where the ship went down.
It sank around the time the Great Pyramid was being built.
Some of the jars may still hold traces of their cargo. Scientists are testing them now.
So what was this ship carrying... when it sank, four thousand seven hundred years ago?
